description: This PHP class defines a 'SupervisorModel' in the OrangeHRM performance API module. It models supervisor data, including employee number, names, and termination ID, and uses traits for serialization and normalization. The class constructs itself based on a 'ReportTo' entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for data serialization.

classes.name: SupervisorModel
classes.description: A model representing supervisor information within the performance API, wrapping a ReportTo entity and facilitating serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SupervisorModel with a ReportTo entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
